There are basically 3 strategies abut spending pure cores from what I read

- pull for a copy of all standard awakeners and move on to hunt Blade of the titan +12 ( wheel )

- pull a copy of all standard awakeners then commit to a single realm to enlighen your main team to +4

- pull for a copy of all standard awakeners then a copy of all wheels then whatever you like
